Here's a can of interesting gourd jam I brought back from a recent trip to Spain - this is actually a delicacy originating from Mallorca.

Here's a link to the recipe I (more or less) followed to make the bayonesa: https://www.directoalpaladar.com/postres/receta-bayonesa-hojaldre-cabello-angel-asi-se-hace-este-clasico-bolleria-espanola
